question: How do rune collision and neighboring-equality rates vary across suggested LP2 artwork sections, particularly pages 40-53 versus 54-55?
source: Archived text/lp2-NN.txt, using the 29 runes in data/index.json. Include headings, exclude number-only page 50 from rune counts.
measures: equal adjacent runes divided by within-page rune edges
length_control: Use every contiguous 308-rune window from the concatenated rune stream of pages 40-53. Count IoC within the window and doublets only at positions that share an original page. Compare the single pages 54-55 score with the distribution of earlier windows. Windows overlap and are descriptive, not independent trials or a p-value.
exclusions: Alternate transcription, word-internal rate, keys, decryptions, section inference, and a generative cipher model.
